question: Can existing own-asset trend signals add profitable activity ONLY when the existing defensive core is instructed to hold cash? Test marginal economic contribution, not another whole-history leverage optimization.
prior_findings: PR132 changed capital/cadence and improved full CAGR but not later stability; aggressive whole-period early/flow blends in PR129/130 failed. V75 leverage-overlay evidence does not replace position-level provenance. This experiment tests a mutually exclusive idle-regime sleeve using already published spot targets; it is not the blocked funding-crowding policy, clock ledger, or a derivatives account.
source: Exact saved Binance/OKX daily data and old results from PR128 run34024683190. Same nine surviving assets and reused economic history, not pristine OOS. No new price endpoints or data selection.
core: Unchanged rotation_stability.build()['guarded_ensemble20'] at weekly cadence. market_allowed from its existing diagnostics determines regime, not observed future cash or profitability. All201 prior daily price rows for all9assets must be complete before an idle sleeve is permitted.
primary: idle_trend10: keep core targets exactly while market_allowed; otherwise substitute10% of existing ensemble_unscaled target. Core and sleeve never hold targets simultaneously. The executor may have residuals/delayed transitions; real model holdings and costs must be replayed, not inferred from target state.
variant_definitions: 05/10/20 are fractions of original unscaled signal, not predicted loss limits. idle_vol10 substitutes half of existing ensemble_vol20 (effective10%forecast risk before drift). idle_breadth10 adds existing three-consecutive-signal-day breadth>=1/3 condition while core off. idle_btc10 is deliberately naive10%BTC when core off, a regime control. daily uses same primary targets but entire account daily execution. always_blend10=.9*core+.1*ensemble_unscaled during complete support, contrast with idle-only. Sleeve-only rows are independent capital controls, NOT addable profit curves. Prior PR132 comparator uses unchanged market-gate25%/3days API.
periods: All13 variants: full2021-01-01 to2026-09-01 exclusive; separate2024 account; separate2025-01-01 to2026-09-01 account. Annual and monthly segments retain calendar zero/loss intervals.
robustness: Primary/core pair: later doubled fee+slip,extra1daydelay,capital1000,pureOKX and full doubled costs. All13variants pureOKXlater (two are duplicate pair evidence but no double-count as independence). Primary/core19 quarterly fresh365daystarts2021-Jan through2025-Jul. No choosing favorable starts or changing allocation after results.
execution: Import old annual_rotation.model.simulate unchanged with one10000USDT cash/coin account,10bpsfee+5bpsadverse slip/side,openD usescloseD-2,native minimum10USDT/lot1e-8/0.1%prior-volume capacity and native residual-null rules. No borrowing, shorting, funding receipts, new ledger or live orders.
primary_acceptance: Complete primary/core full/later; greater fullCAGR AND greater laternet than core; fullDD no worse by morethan2percentagepoints; all primary later costs/delay/OKXpositive; more completedlaterassetpositions; no fewer positive quarterlystarts and no worse worststart. A failed test remains failed. Annual500 target separately requires actually computed CAGR>=500 and every fullcalendar>=500; future profit cannot be guaranteed.
verification: Prefix invariance; future-price changes leave earlier targets unchanged; active-core target identity; mutually exclusive target budgets; incomplete201day support refuses sleeve; oldweeklyfull/later and PR132full/later exact report identity; independent cash/integerlot reconciliation. Full root regressions and clean second-run exact result/fill reproduction.
selection_and_boundaries: Primary fixed before results, all variants retained, no post-result hyperparameter search in this pass. Any best alternative is exploratory. Target cash is not guaranteed actual flatness; terminal residues and liquidity rejections matter. No changes to production profiles, broker adapters or scheduling. Finite current-turn computation; no indefinite background task.
